entries.title: Dispatch endpoint missing from integration job
entries.root_cause: The integration job does not provide OCHRE_DISPATCH_URL, which the dispatch client configuration requires. Set the dispatch endpoint in that job.

entries.title: Archive endpoint missing from integration job
entries.root_cause: The integration job does not provide OCHRE_ARCHIVE_URL, which the archive client configuration requires. Set the archive endpoint in that job.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same configuration validation fails for the archive client and its separate endpoint, rather than the dispatch client.

entries.title: Archive endpoint still absent
entries.root_cause: The integration job does not provide OCHRE_ARCHIVE_URL, which the archive client configuration requires. Set the archive endpoint in that job.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run selects another archive test and reports a shifted source line after edits, with different runner and test output.

entries.title: Dispatch endpoint still absent
entries.root_cause: The integration job does not provide OCHRE_DISPATCH_URL, which the dispatch client configuration requires. Set the dispatch endpoint in that job.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run selects a different dispatch test and uses a newer Go version; unrelated source edits shifted the configuration line.
